title: Evaluating Gender Bias in Hindi-English Machine Translation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating bias in Hindi-English machine translation using Word Embedding Fairness Evaluation (WEFE) metrics (WEAT, RND, RNSB, ECT) on word embeddings, and measuring contextual translation bias using a modified Translation Gender Bias Index (TGBI) on translated sentences containing gender-neutral pronouns, occupations, and sentiment words.
